content.short: Degen Wallet unifies DeFi and NFT features with streamlined onboarding.
content.description: Degen Wallet brings together DeFi and NFT features in a single platform, acting as a one-stop hub for all crypto activities. It enables yield farming, staking, and NFT sales with a streamlined onboarding experience and no need to store complex seed phrases. The wallet supports multiple networks, including Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, Base, OP Mainnet, Avalanche, Aptos, Bitcoin, and Celo, delivering cross-chain access and a cohesive user experience in one place.
content.meta: Degen Wallet is a crypto solution that integrates DeFi and NFTs with onboarding. Discover Degen Wallet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
